Question: IMC / Nagar Nigam Indore ka head office kahan hai? (Where is the IMC head office located?)
Answer: Indore Municipal Corporation ka head office Nagar Nigam Square, Rajwada area, Indore (Madhya Pradesh, pin 452007) mein hai. Ye jaankari public directories se li gayi hai, official confirmation ke liye website check kar lein — apna nearest ward/zonal office aksar zyada convenient bhi padta hai roz ke kaam ke liye.

Question: IMC ki official website kya hai? (What is IMC's official website?)
Answer: https://imcindore.mp.gov.in/ — yahan se online complaints darj kar sakte hain, property tax pay kar sakte hain, aur department-wise services dekh sakte hain.
